faq_q1: Downloaded file shows as "damaged" or won't open?
faq_a1: KongGoo is Apple Notarized, so this shouldn't normally happen. If it does, run in Terminal:
faq_q2: Can't find "Developer Mode" in iPhone Settings?
faq_a2: This option is only available on iOS 16+, and your iPhone needs to be connected to a computer via USB first. Click "Initialize Connection" in KongGoo, then go to Settings → Privacy & Security at the bottom.
faq_q3: Is there a time limit for Route mode?
faq_a3: Yes, Route mode currently runs for up to 5 minutes per session. This ensures location simulation stability. You can restart anytime.
faq_q4: Will I be charged automatically after the free trial?
faq_a4: No. After the 1-week free trial, the app will prompt you to purchase, but won't charge automatically. Choose Annual (NT$690) or Lifetime (NT$1,750).
faq_q5: How many devices can one license key be used on?
faq_a5: Each license key is bound to one device. Contact support for device transfer if needed.
faq_q6: Why does macOS ask for a password during initialization?
faq_a6: macOS requires admin privileges for USB communication with iOS devices. Enter your computer login password — this is normal security behavior.
